arms.A: Legacy correct-plus-one preservation rivals. Existing conditional-margin guard is a diagnostic flag only. All numerical probes run actual generation.
arms.B: Corrected comparison rivals. Existing conditional-margin guard is a diagnostic flag only. All numerical probes run actual generation.
arms.C: Reuse B's exact rounded probes. Select only endpoint-qualified probes by target item gain and then smallest realized norm.
arms.D: Reuse B's exact rounded probes. Rank endpoint-qualified probes by measured target logistic loss plus 0.2 times full-vocabulary preservation-prefix KL plus 0.1 times squared realized norm. This applies measured regularization to selection; it does not differentiate KL or generate additional directions.
arms.control_accounting: A and B have the same fit rows, rank, radii, and endpoint budget. B/C/D share exact corrected candidate trajectories. No-adaptation parent is measured. A separately trained conventional tuning baseline is outside this bounded pilot; it is required before a scientific comparison of optimizer performance.
arms.practice_gate: At least one additional completed correct target item in both wordings and a both-wordings correction of at least one previously repeated smaller-negative error. Zero lost validity and zero baseline-correct presentation regressions. Every eligible checkpoint must first pass the actual endpoint; diagnostic A/B flags never authorize materialization.
arms.prefix_controls: Both wordings of the first solved positive and first solved copy item in frozen practice order. Evaluate the full vocabulary along the observed accepted generation, including its completion boundary when available.

design.A: Whole-answer contrastive loss against actual displayed rival; fixed layer 23, rank-one constrained synthesis.
design.B: First-fork objective, fixed layer 23, rank-one update.
design.C: First-fork objective, rank-one update on the frozen scan winner.
design.D: First-fork objective with sampled decision-margin preservation on the same scan winner.
design.E: Full-affine rank-four Adam baseline on complete accepted continuations. Train on fixed layer 23 for four steps, including matched correct preservation rows. Test the natural trained merge once if it meets the declared .35 realized norm cap.
design.duplicate_policy: Deduplicate identical rounded tensor states across arms. Report equivalent arms against the same full endpoint observation. Abstain on no-op or invalid numerical output.
design.fork_loss: full-vocabulary negative log probability of accepted next-token set
design.practice_gate: At least one additional target correct in both wordings, at least one correction from the frozen repeatable error set, no loss of valid outputs, and no regression of any previously correct practice presentation.
design.scope: Five arms, one primary probe per arm. Rank-one A through D share radii, target items, endpoint budget and stored update limits. Use matched full-generation practice guards and compare new checkpoints independently only after practice passes. Layer scan and conventional training have separately accounted compute.

hypothesis: The generic fork and trajectory diagnostics can replay native Llama-family greedy decisions.
Stratification, margin inequalities and refitting on observed practice counterexamples can retain repeatable corrections with zero prohibited regressions on independent data.

design.A: First-fork rank-one projection with four global low-margin anchors, using first two solved target items, first solved positive item and first solved copy item in frozen roster order.
design.B: Same rank-one projection and fixed nominal .05 dose, with one lowest eligible margin in each preservation group and wording cell.
design.C: Same evidence as B, solve individual token-margin inequalities in the fixed right-factor rank-one space, projected inside the .05 norm ball.
design.D: Start with C. If a complete practice probe regresses previously correct outputs, add up to two verified decisions in frozen roster order and refit from parent. At most two refits.
design.E: Freeze the C/D anchor set before the dose stage. Rank decoded C/D observations by practice pass, fewer prohibited regressions, more repeatable errors corrected, higher item gain, then earlier arm. If none decoded use C. Refit the same formulation at each frozen dose and deduplicate stored tensors.
design.fit_selection: First four repeatable-error items whose two observed forks validate, in frozen roster order. No independent results inform construction, radius, or arm choice.
design.limitations: A uses the historical four-anchor pool and B uses eight anchors to cover four groups and two forms. A versus B changes coverage and anchor count. Hold both fixed in B versus C. Risk-weighted sampling is a bounded diagnostic comparison.
design.practice_gate: Require at least one additional target solved across both wordings and a both-wording correction of a repeatable wrong negative. Require zero losses of valid outputs and zero regressions of previously correct presentations.
design.primary_limits: Nine unique complete practice measurements maximum, one rank-one region per arm, 16,384 touched entries maximum, .055 maximum realized norm to allow for BF16 rounding. Nominal doses are Frobenius ball radii.
design.risk_sampling: Record a risk-ranked subset of gradient-measured decisions using directional slopes and parent margins. This is diagnostic only; full-trajectory gradient scanning is outside this CPU pilot.

hypothesis: Sensitivity-selected preservation and calibrated positive slack produce a correction that transfers with no prohibited regression.

design.A: One lowest eligible margin per presentation then historical global low-margin selection from the preservation-fit pool, eight anchors. Existing inequality solver, zero floor.
design.B: Same preservation-fit pool and capacity. One anchor per required group and wording cell using directional adverse movement divided by available parent margin. Existing inequality solver, zero floor.
design.C: Same B anchors and solver. Add calibration-only positive floor and empirical adverse allowance.
design.D: Reuse only C candidates that pass the complete practice gate. Require at least one positive local safe width and strictly positive minimum measured anchor margin. Rank by largest minimum measured margin above the calibrated floor, then largest maximum safe width, highest practice item gain, smallest realized BF16 norm, and earlier dose. If none eligible abstain.
design.E: Lock the selected D candidate before opening the preservation-validation outcomes. Independently reload it and require zero previously correct response regressions and zero valid-response losses on that partition before independent selection. No further fitting.
design.allowance_rule: Estimate one common adverse allowance as the nonnegative 80th percentile (higher empirical order statistic) of worst adverse margin residual per underlying calibration item, using the rounded preferred rank-one direction at the directional secant radius. Use no validation observations in floor or allowance selection.
design.calibration_scope: Residual allowances are diagnostics for one short preferred direction and a small number of independent underlying items. Compute a separate preservation-validation residual audit only after A–D are locked, at the same calibration direction and dose; use these VJPs only for audit, never for solving or refitting.
design.compute_limits: Six unique A/B/C full practice probes maximum. Each probe decodes both adaptation and preservation-fit. Separate full validation decode only for D survivor. Directional and calibration temporary probes measure logits only. No secondary geometry study in this CPU pilot.
design.duplicate_policy: Deduplicate exactly rounded tensor states across A–C. Reuse behavioral observations only for identical states. Report the nominal dose, realized BF16 norm, support, and arm-specific active-constraint margin checks.
design.fitting_scope: First four adaptation items with replay-matched forks in both wordings. Preservation gradient VJPs only on selected anchors in preservation-fit and calibration. Neither preservation-validation nor selection or hidden is routed into optimization.
design.floor_rule: Choose the largest positive grid value no greater than half the 25th percentile of calibration-anchor parent margins, using the lower empirical order statistic. If none meets the bound, abstain for C through E. Use the same floor for all active B anchors in C.
design.max_gain_comparator: Compare D against the C practice passer with largest target gain, then smallest realized norm and earlier dose. Report when neither exists or they coincide.
design.practice_gate: Require one new correct target item in both wordings and one correction of a repeatable negative error across both wordings on adaptation. Require zero losses of valid responses and zero regressions of previously correct presentations on both adaptation and preservation-fit.
design.sampler_controls: Also record stratified low-margin and unstratified directional selections on the identical pool and capacity. These are coverage/risk-prediction diagnostics, not extra decoded arms.
